Post.title: Post
Post.description: Represents a post in the AnonyCollab application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Post entity.

title.description: The title or question of the post.

problemSummary.description: A short summary of the problem.

whatIveTried.description: Details on what has been tried to solve the problem.

whatIveTriedSummary.description: A short summary of what has been tried.

expectedOutcomeSummary.description: A short summary of the expected outcome.

sector.description: The industry sector the post relates to.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the post.

imageUrl.description: URL of an optional image for the post.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the post was created.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment on a post.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Comment entity.

postId.description: Reference to the Post this comment belongs to. (Relationship: Post 1:N Comment)

text.description: The text content of the comment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the comment was created.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user's private data and relationships.

friends.description: An array of UIDs of the user's friends.

FriendRequest.title: Friend Request
FriendRequest.description: Represents a friend request between two users.

senderId.description: UID of the user sending the request.

receiverId.description: UID of the user receiving the request.

DirectMessage.title: Direct Message Conversation
DirectMessage.description: Represents a direct message conversation between users, which can be a 1-on-1 or a group chat.

participants.description: An array of UIDs of the participants in the DM.

isGroup.description: If true, this is a group chat.

groupName.description: The name of the group, if applicable.

groupAvatar.description: URL for the group's avatar, if applicable.

createdAt.description: Timestamp for when the conversation was created.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a conversation. It can be a standard text message or a special type, like a shared post or file.

senderId.description: The UID of the user who sent the message.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

type.description: The type of the message. Defaults to 'text'.

text.description: The text content of the message. Required for 'text' type messages.

postId.description: The ID of the shared post. Required for 'postShare' type messages.

fileInfo.description: Metadata for a shared file. Required for 'file' type messages.

firestore.reasoning:
The data structure is designed to be simple and directly reflect the entity relationships described. It prioritizes straightforward access patterns and avoids unnecessary complexity. The structure enforces path-based ownership for comments within posts to ensure data integrity and simplifies security rules. All access is based on unauthenticated access with Post visibility being implicitly 'Public'.

Authorization Independence is achieved inherently because there is no explicit need for authorization besides the potential of requiring logged in status for posting. All posts are public. The use of subcollections for comments, while straightforward, doesn't necessitate denormalization in this public-access scenario. If comments needed role-based access, the post's member list or owner would be denormalized into the comment documents.

The structure supports list operations (QAPs) by leveraging the natural hierarchy. Listing comments for a specific post is efficient via a collection group query on the `/posts/{postId}/comments` subcollection. Listing posts themselves is also direct from `/posts`.
